limitations: All 30 published outputs remain tentative_continuous. Identity, absolute orientation, and trusted-memory flags remain false; 29 private neural-holder commits do not promote identity trust.
Full saved observable-path parity is not independent neural/gradient recomputation, GT accuracy or physical identity proof. Missing external SAM logits/scorer observations remain outside the scope.
One existing-mesh 30-input development prefix has actual GPU execution plus full parity. The new revision meshless branch has CPU dry-run validation only; no new-root meshless GPU result is claimed.
Timing is one descriptive run with initialization, tracking, child and parent boundaries kept separate. No statistical significance, held-out generalization, deployment FPS or new speed conclusion.
Native ZIP_STORED is explicitly selected for this run. The default remains numpy_default; motion and other product writers retain default compression. Writes do not call fsync.
Codec counts and byte totals below cover native/motion packet archives, not the entire run directory. Empty archives have no member codec to observe and are counted separately.

observable_parity.comparison_scope: All saved observable numeric/product/packet values plus current permissions, publication decisions and holder chain.

timing.initialization_boundary: mesh/frame loading + first-frame mask/click + FP setup + complete candidate registration/assessment + current-input GFTT and tentative measured session startup + evidence serialization; no trusted-memory initialization + continuity decision and publication evidence
timing.reduction_method: math.fsum and independent sorted linear percentile interpolation at (n-1)*p
timing.scope: One descriptive actual run; no matched performance comparison or new speed/FPS conclusion.
timing.tracking_boundary: decode + shared measured-motion session + actual adaptive FP + CUDA sync; session evidence included, final output serialization excluded; current-frame continuity decision and publication evidence included
